code_freeze.pre_freeze_verification: Full pytest suite, Ruff, compileall, git diff --check, v35 141-task matched-prefix analysis, preservation false-failure audit, and pinned Godot 4.4.1 fresh-import probes completed on 2026-08-17.

experiment.infrastructure_policy: Model-caused invalid output or code failure remains FAIL. A deterministic Harness admission limit remains BLOCKED and counts against coverage. A zero-turn pre-request infrastructure failure may receive one recorded retry; a repeated failure remains ERROR, is excluded from conditional accuracy, and is counted as a failure in the all-eligible lower-bound score.
experiment.primary_endpoint: official evaluator PASS over all 332 eligible tasks
experiment.stop_rule: Stop before an attempt if weekly subscription remaining is below 35%. No task replacement or runtime change is permitted after protocol freeze.

official_reference.comparison_note: The public leaderboard does not include per-task outcomes. Because exactly one ground-truth-invalid task is excluded, Official's qualified score is reported as the two-value range obtained by assuming that task either passed or failed.

qualification.method: Before any full-run model outcome, execute the benchmark's official validator on every ground-truth project using the benchmark-specified engine. Exclude only tasks whose ground truth fails both the parallel run and sequential retry.
